defaultOpenEffect: New cards are open — the board or any agent can respond, including the one that asked.
uncappedEffect: A request keeps whatever audience it asks for.
defaultNotCreatorEffect: New cards exclude the agent that created them, so the answer comes from someone else.
defaultHumanOnlyEffect: New cards wait for a person on the board. Agents are turned away.
capNotCreatorEffect: Even a card that asks for Anyone is narrowed to exclude its creator.
capHumanOnlyEffect: Every card of this kind waits for a person, whatever it asked for.
